simple.meaning: נֵתַח (nêthach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a fragment.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Judges, Ezekiel, beginning at Exodus 29:17. Its contexts include family line, offering, altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֵתַח (H5409).

definitions.full: H5409. nethach נֵ֫תַח noun masculine Ezek 24:4 piece of a divided carcass (Ecclus נתחים Ecclesiasticus 50:12a); — absolute ׳נ 24:4 ; plural נְתָחִים Judg 19:29 2 t.; suffix נְתָחָיו Exod 29:17 (twice in verse) + 2t., נְתָחֶ֫יהָ Lev 1:6 3 t.; **read נְתָחֶיהָ also Ezek 24:5 for MT רתחיה Hi-Sm Co Berthol Toy Siegf Kau Krae Da ('possibly'). — usually plural pieces: of meat in a caldron (symbolic of Jerusalem) 24:4 (twice in verse) (singular only 24:4 b), 24:6 ; 24:6 ; of sacrificial animals Exod 29:17 b Lev 1:8 ; 8:20 ; b 9:13 ; elsewhere ׳לִנ after verb נִתַּה (q. v.): of woman Judg 19:29 ; Exod 29:17 a Lev 1:6 , 12 ; 8:20 a.
